newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to issue one-year domestic bonds next week.
newsitem.headline: Romania to issue one-year domestic bonds next week.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Thursday it would launch an issue of 1.132 trillion lei worth of 371-day domestic bonds next week to refinance the budget deficit.
A ministry order published in the Official Gazette said the interest-bearing bonds would be placed next Tuesday by the central bank through a single-price auction.
It said investors would be allowed to submit a maximum of five competitive bids with a 100 million lei face value each. The interest will be paid twice a year, on February 20 and August 27, 1998.

Under the current rules, government paper is available to commercial banks operating in Romania and their resident corporate clients. Non-residents' access to the primary market of government securities has yet to be regulated.
The Ministry has recently launched six-month treasury bills, after issuing only 91-day bills over the past year, in a bid to improve domestic debt management,
Investors rushed to buy the longer-maturity paper, pushing the six-month T-bill yield to an annual 55.01 percent at Wednesday's auction from 44.01 percent a week ago.
